proofs.text: At the gate `strong`, whose minimum is 70, commit a ci record measuring 48 in which both proofs pass; build the payload and verify the strong cell of the rule whose proofs raise `happy_path_only` reads `weak` with the reasons `["strength 48% under 70%", "happy_path_only"]` in that order

rule_text: A test strength under `min_strength` makes the strong cell read `weak` with the reason `strength <n>% under <m>%`, and every free-check finding on the proof text is named after it

tests.body:
def test_a_strength_under_the_minimum_is_weak_and_names_the_findings(self):
        made = Project(gate='strong', extra_config={'ai_review_at': 'never'})
        try:
            made.record([{'id': 'PROOF-1', 'rule': 'RULE-1', 'status': 'pass'},
                         {'id': 'PROOF-2', 'rule': 'RULE-2', 'status': 'pass'}],
                        ci=True, strength=48)
            cell = made.cell('RULE-1', 'strong')
            assert cell['word'] == 'weak'
            assert cell['reasons'] == ['strength 48% under 70%',
                                       'happy_path_only'], cell
        finally:
            made.close()
